opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship (2027)

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship is fully funded and will include all travel and subsistence, for the duration of the tour. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig).
opportunities.summary: Develops young talent in agriculture through a 30-day study tour staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, building networks and future opportunities. Fully funded including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. In 2027 the Trust plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
